customAgreementTypes.description: Completed supplier agreement reviewed for renewal risk, notice deadlines, and agreement value.
customAgreementTypes.aiDefinition: A supplier, vendor, services, subscription, maintenance, catering, calibration, office supply, or software agreement that may renew, auto-renew, expire, or require advance notice before renewal.

fields.aiDefinition: The supplier, vendor, counterparty, or service provider name for the agreement.

en.exampleText: This Workplace Supplies Subscription Agreement is entered into by and between Acme Corporation and Brightline Office Supplies LLC.
Customer engages Meridian Catering Services Inc. to provide event catering services.
Northstar Maintenance Group LLC shall provide facilities maintenance services under this Agreement.

fields.aiDefinition: The annual, renewal, subscription, or recurring contract value for the agreement expressed as a number without currency symbols.

en.exampleText: The annual subscription fee is $82,000.
Customer shall pay Vendor USD 42,000 per renewal term.
The current annual services value is ninety-six thousand dollars.

fields.aiDefinition: The currency used for the agreement value, such as USD, EUR, or GBP.

en.exampleText: The annual subscription fee is $82,000 USD.
All fees are payable in United States dollars.
Customer shall pay Vendor USD 42,000 per renewal term.

fields.aiDefinition: Whether the agreement auto-renews, requires manual renewal, is evergreen, has no renewal, or does not state renewal terms.

en.exampleText: This Agreement automatically renews for successive one-year terms unless either party provides written notice.
Any renewal must be agreed in writing by both parties before the end of the current term.
The agreement continues until terminated by either party.

fields.aiDefinition: The next renewal, auto-renewal, expiration, or term end date that determines when renewal action is needed.

en.exampleText: The Agreement will automatically renew on October 15, 2026.
The current term ends and renews on August 19, 2026.
The renewal date for the next term is September 30, 2026.

fields.aiDefinition: The number of days of advance written notice required to cancel, change, or prevent renewal.

en.exampleText: Either party must provide at least 60 days written notice before the renewal date.
Customer may prevent renewal by giving Vendor 30 days prior written notice.
Notice of non-renewal must be delivered no fewer than forty-five days before renewal.

fields.aiDefinition: The last calendar date by which notice must be sent to cancel, change, or prevent renewal. If the agreement only states renewal date and notice period, the app can derive this field.

en.exampleText: Notice must be received no later than August 16, 2026.
The deadline for notice of non-renewal is July 20, 2026.
Written cancellation notice must be delivered by June 5, 2026.
